verdict.rationale: Metronome exposes a full REST API (confirmed via OpenAPI spec) with bearer-token auth, list endpoints with pagination, and object queries for contracts, invoices, customers, and billable metrics, so an agent could programmatically query billing state like customer invoices, contract history, and revenue data. However, there is no explicit endpoint or documentation for aggregate metrics like MRR, delinquent-account status, or upcoming-renewal alerts, and no evidence of an agent-native interface (e.g., MCP server or natural-language query layer) — access would require custom integration work rather than direct agent querying as described. Missing for 10: explicit MRR/delinquency/renewal query endpoints, agent-facing interface or MCP server, and any hands-on evidence of an agent successfully answering these billing questions.
